name: 颜色规则
description: 色板合规、颜色语义、填充/描边约束

rules.name: 色板合规
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'lint-fail' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('color-palette'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '使用了规范色板之外的颜色', impact: '颜色不一致，不符合 §2.1.1', suggestedFix: '将颜色替换为规范色板中的颜色，或确认后加入色板', severity: 'high' }; }

rules.name: 颜色语义正确性
rules.detect: function(eventType, payload) { return eventType === 'lint-fail' && payload.error && payload.error.includes('semantic'); }
rules.analyze: function(payload) { return { rootCause: '颜色语义错误（如用蓝表示数据库）', impact: '违反颜色编码约定', suggestedFix: '按 §2.1.2 颜色语义映射修正', severity: 'high' }; }
